name: Igawa Natsume
source:
"The Little Devil in a Rich Girl's Body"

She’s always hanging out with Kurumi Kinoshita and the Kurotani sisters.

She’s the mastermind behind causing trouble without getting her hands dirty, dragging those around her into the chaos. She’s the most malicious girl in the school.

Sometimes she flatters people, and other times she acts in a way that makes others feel insignificant.

Lately, perhaps because she hasn’t been getting along well with her father, she seems to be taking it out on those around her.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/dmc/cha/cha02.html]official site[/url]]
